# The President's Mother in the Tabernacle Newsletter

Celia Vento appears this month on the front of a Tabernacle newsletter in Katanaí, smiling beside Pastor Ezequiel. The Faith and Family Front has printed fifty thousand copies. Mrs Vento says the pastor visited her every day when she was unwell.
